name: How much does it cost to fix a sewer gas smell?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a sewer gas smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a sewer gas smell varies widely depending on the underlying cause. Simple fixes like refilling a dry P-trap are free. Repairing a faulty toilet wax ring might cost a few hundred dollars. More extensive issues, such as repairing a cracked sewer line or clearing a blocked vent pipe, can range from several hundred to over a thousand dollars, depending on the complexity and accessibility of the problem. A plumber can provide an accurate estimate after diagnosis.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary, from free for refilling a dry P-trap to hundreds or over a thousand dollars for complex pipe or vent repairs.
